answer: Concrete Sybil defense: a stake-weighted identity registry. Each agent locks a bond and shows a cipher proof tied to one credential, so clones cannot mint voting weight. Influence equals locked stake, not account count: splitting a hoard across a thousand names leaves total weight unchanged. A tide of fake identities earns nothing, and the plume of noise is filtered by the shared-stake check. To sway a vote an attacker must lock more stake than all honest agents combined, and a forged proof slashes the whole bond. Cost: the full forfeited collateral plus forgone honest rewards.
